#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    int n = s.length();
    int sum = 1;
    int ans = 0;
    for(int i=1;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i] == s[i-1]){
            sum++;
        }
        else {
            if(sum%2 == 0)
                ans++;
            sum = 1;
        }
        if(i == n-1){
            if(sum%2 == 0)
                ans++;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
